basis: muxui:decision:0022:amendment:01: retroactive independent review of the current code for the R1.4 families
claimBoundary: findings is not a pass. clear means the reviewer found nothing within the stated lenses, files, tests, and probes; it is not proof of correctness. A fixed resolution means a fix merged in pull request #204 with tests that fail without it; independent reviewers verified those tests on the pull-request branch before merge, and nobody re-reviewed the code after merge. An accepted-unfixed resolution is the decision owner's acceptance, not a fix. Manual and assistive-technology testing remains unmet and deferred to S1.0 (Decision 0022). This is not a hosted review of the original pull request, which had none.
expiry: Retained as historical R1 review evidence for the reviewed commit; a later code change needs a new review rather than an edit. Only the resolution of each finding is updated, by this tool.

families.reportTableVerdict: clear in its own code; causes the DropZone defect when nested

findings.summary: PreviewTrigger steals focus whenever the preview opens, by hover or by keyboard focus.
Dismissing a Toast with the keyboard drops focus to body.
A declarative Toast is torn down and re-added on every parent render unless every prop is referentially stable.
A non-modal Popover cannot be dismissed by an outside click, or by Escape on the trigger.
dismissable={false} on Popover can be bypassed.
Toast timers ignore hover that starts during the entry animation and can leak an unpausable timeout.
disabled on Tooltip and PreviewTrigger marks the still-working trigger aria-disabled.
DropZone onActivate fires from any nested control click, sometimes twice.
An uncontrolled Dialog with dismissable={false} can never close.

resolution.reason: Known limitation accepted by Andrew for rc.1: focus falls to body when the element that opened a Dialog unmounts while it is open; no Mux UI fallback target.

findings.summary: Focus is lost to body when the element that opened a Dialog unmounts while it is open.
Missing proof for focus, dismissal, timing, drag-and-drop, and FileTrigger contracts.
A declarative Toast whose onDismiss unmounts it cuts the exit animation short.
DropZone puts aria-disabled on a div with no role.
normalizeMaxVisible silently turns invalid values into 5.
Dialog has no aria-modal; the catalog wording overstates modal semantics.
